ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a block diagram of a negative feedback system. The input first enters a summing node marked with “+” and “-”; in the forward path there is an amplifier block, labeled “100 ± 10%”; a part of the signal at the output end returns via the lower feedback branch to the negative end of the summing node, and in the feedback branch there is an attenuator block, labeled “9/100”. Reasoning: According to the negative feedback closed-loop gain formula, if the forward amplifier gain is A and the feedback coefficient is β, then the closed-loop gain T = A / (1 + Aβ). Here the nominal value of A is 100, the tolerance is ±10%, and β = 9/100 = 0.09. The nominal closed-loop gain is T = 100 / (1 + 100 × 0.09) = 100 / (1 + 9) = 100 / 10 = 10. Since the loop gain Aβ = 9, the sensitivity of the closed-loop gain to changes in forward gain is approximately 1 / (1 + Aβ) = 1/10. Therefore, the ±10% tolerance of the amplifier itself will be reduced by negative feedback by about 10 times, becoming about ±1% tolerance of the overall gain. So the overall system gain is approximately 10 ± 1%.

raw_record.question_text: A negative feedback system has an amplifier of gain 100 with ±10% tolerance in the forward path, and an attenuator of value 9/100 in the feedback path. The overall system gain is approximately ______.

method.method_draft: Identify A = 100 nominal with ±10% tolerance and β = 9/100 = 0.09. Compute nominal closed-loop gain: T = 100/(1 + 100·0.09) = 100/10 = 10. For tolerance, the loop gain Aβ = 9, so sensitivity of T to A is 1/(1 + Aβ) = 1/10. Therefore the amplifier’s ±10% tolerance becomes approximately ±1% in overall gain. Conclude the overall system gain is approximately 10 ± 1%.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图是一个负反馈系统框图。输入先进入带“+”和“-”标记的求和节点；前向通道中有一个放大器方框，标注为“100 ± 10%”；输出端的一部分信号经下方反馈支路返回到求和节点的负端，反馈支路中有一个衰减器方框，标注为“9/100”。

推理：按负反馈闭环增益公式，若前向放大器增益为 A，反馈系数为 β，则闭环增益 T = A / (1 + Aβ)。这里 A 的标称值为 100，容差为 ±10%，β = 9/100 = 0.09。标称闭环增益为 T = 100 / (1 + 100 × 0.09) = 100 / (1 + 9) = 100 / 10 = 10。由于环路增益 Aβ = 9，闭环增益对前向增益变化的灵敏度约为 1 / (1 + Aβ) = 1/10。因此放大器本身的 ±10% 容差会被负反馈降低约 10 倍，变成整体增益的约 ±1% 容差。所以整体系统增益约为 10 ± 1%。
